name: drift-tube-spread
description: Closed form: sqrt(seed^2 + 2 D t) with D = mu kT / q, the Einstein relation, and mu declared rather than derived. The one per cent tolerance is not a modelling allowance - the measured value sits at 1.2e-5 of it - but the room a change in the grid or the step scheme may legitimately move it. What it cannot absorb is a diffusion coefficient wrong by any meaningful factor, which is the failure this guards. The packet is entirely retained over the window, so the width is of the whole population and not of a truncated remnant.
